info.name: Web grading service
info.description:
Auth (since 2026-09-30, Keycloak integration):
- Direct to a service (default): send X-User-Id plus X-Gateway-Secret (Postman variable `serviceSecret` = GATEWAY_TRUSTED_SECRET from the repo .env). Requests without the secret are rejected with 401.
- Through the api-gateway: enable the disabled `Authorization: Bearer {{token}}` header and obtain a token from the ptit-wgs realm. The gateway replaces any X-User-Id you send with the token subject, so X-User-Id is ignored in that mode.
Roles (since 2026-09-30, slice 2): the collection sends `X-User-Roles: {{roles}}` on every request. `roles` defaults to `LECTURER` in the environment; set it to `STUDENT` (or delete the header) when exercising the student side, because class/assignment/plan/image endpoints and the two lecturer grading-view endpoints (GET /api/v1/assignments/{id}/results, GET /api/v1/assignments/{id}/submissions) now answer 403 without LECTURER. The old public route GET /api/v1/submissions/assignment/{id} is gone: it is internal now and course-service fronts it with an owner check.
See docs/api/postman/FULL_FLOW_TESTING_GUIDE.md section 0.
